overall_summary: Deduplicated analysis of 42 unique Shorts reveals a stark performance divergence across niches. High-concept exoplanet extremes combined with first-person experiential hooks ('What If You Fell Into...') consistently drive peak metrics (700-1,030+ views, up to 3.7% like ratio), whereas cognitive psychology and generic trivia ('Your Brain...', earworms, fake memories) suffer severe algorithmic suppression (5-70 views, near-zero engagement). Videos formatted between 19 and 21 seconds with visceral, lethal planetary environments generate the channel's strongest velocity.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Survival / Lethal Exoplanet 'What If' Hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes), 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (824 views, 15 likes), and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) significantly outperform the catalog average.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on hypothetical first-person descent/survival scenarios set on extreme celestial bodies, pairing visceral physical sensations with high-contrast cinematic visual pacing.

winning_patterns.pattern: Paradoxical Space Physics & Exotic Planetary Geology
winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,031 views, 36 likes) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) achieved top-tier reach without relying on recycled trivia tropes.
winning_patterns.action: Focus space scripts on mind-bending physical contradictions (e.g., perpetual darkness, relativistic speeds, magnetic shredding) rather than passive textbook facts.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Psychology and Brain Quirk Facts
weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' across multiple iterations collapsed at 5-53 views and 0 likes; 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' stalled at 17 views.
weak_patterns.action: Deprecate standalone cognitive psychology facts unless integrated into a dramatic micro-thriller or high-stakes survival context.

weak_patterns.pattern: Repetitive Topic Retreads Without Angle Differentiation
weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated uploads of 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' (34-220 views) and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (118-363 views) yielded diminishing returns compared to unique exoplanet concepts.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict uniqueness constraints: avoid re-covering topics already covered within the past 60 days.
